title: 第1124章 该欠的人情要欠第1123章 虚海诡影
slug: 聚灵飞升第1126章暗流之下
content_zh:
太虚仙域的界壁如同温润的纱幕，灵舟穿过时带起的涟漪在青白色的光幕上缓缓扩散，随即又恢复了平静。
云昊站在船头，入目的是一片与精玄仙域截然不同的天地。
天空是深沉的墨蓝色，云层低垂厚重，如同被墨色浸染过的棉絮堆积在远山与天际之间。
大地上山脉起伏连绵，山峰的轮廓在薄雾中若隐若现，山间散落着大大小小的湖泊，湖水澄澈如镜，倒映着天空的墨蓝色，将天地连成一片浑然一体的画卷。
空气中弥漫着浓郁的木属性仙气，带着草木特有的清冽气息，深吸一口便觉经脉中混元仙力的运转都顺畅了几分。
他们一路走哪儿算哪儿，没想到到了太虚仙域中，算是到了顾长风的地盘。
付荣走到他身边：“精玄仙域以金石之利着称，太虚仙域则以木蕴生机闻名。
这里的木属性仙气比精玄仙域浓郁了数倍，对修炼木属性功法的修士来说是天赐之地。”
不过对你来说，建木之力与这里的天地法则恰好契合，修炼速度应该能比在精玄仙域时更快一些。”
云昊没有说话，只是微微点头。
他能感觉到建木之力对这片天地的呼应，如同根系感知到了湿润的土壤。
玄色古木的虚影在丹田中微微震颤了一下，随即恢复了平静。
灵舟在太虚仙域的边缘飞行了两日，沿途的景色从苍茫的山脉逐渐变成平缓的丘陵，丘陵上散落着一些村落和城镇，规模不大，但都笼罩在浓郁的木属性仙气中。
第三日清晨，前方的地平线上出现了一座规模宏大的城池。
城池依山而建，城墙由青色的巨石砌成，石缝中生满了翠绿色的苔藓，在晨光下泛着温润的光泽。
城墙上方缭绕着一层薄薄的白雾，如同一顶轻纱盖在城头。
城门上方挂着一块巨大的木匾，刻着三个古朴的大字——“太虚城”
付荣放缓了灵舟的速度：“太虚城是太虚仙域南部的第一重镇，也是前往中天仙域的重要中转站。
从这里往东再走三月，就能抵达仙域之间的跨界传送阵。”
云昊看了一眼城中的轮廓：“我们先在这里停一天。”

灵舟在太虚城外的码头降落。
码头不大，但停泊着数艘样式各异的灵舟，有的来自精玄仙域，有的来自更遥远的北辰仙域，还有几艘通体漆黑的骨舟，船身上刻着云昊不认识的古老符文。
云昊走下灵舟，沿着青石铺成的街道向城中走去。
街道两旁的店铺大多是木制的，门楣上雕刻着花草藤蔓的纹样，有药铺、符箓铺、法宝阁，一家不起眼的茶馆引起了云昊的注意。
茶馆门口摆着一张木桌，桌上放着一块旧木牌，上面写着“太虚宗外务接待处”
几个字。
云昊走到茶馆门口时，一个穿着青色道袍的年轻弟子正好从里面走出来，看到云昊先是愣了一下，然后目光在他身上停住了。
那年轻弟子快步上前，拱手道：“敢问阁下可是万墟宗云宗主？”
云昊看了他一眼：“你认识我？”
年轻弟子的脸上露出惊喜之色：“晚辈太虚宗内门弟子林远，曾在宗门典籍中见过云宗主的画像。
顾师叔祖前日传讯回宗，说云宗主正在前往中天仙域途中，让我们留意，若是遇到务必好生接待。
云宗主请随晚辈来。”
他侧身让开门口，做了个“请”
的手势。
云昊没有推辞，抬步走进了茶馆。
茶馆不大但收拾得干净明亮，窗边的雅座可以看到街景。
林远将他引到雅座坐下，亲自沏了一壶茶，茶汤碧绿透亮，清香扑鼻。
“这是太虚仙域特产的‘青木灵芽’，顾师叔祖说云宗主喜欢喝茶，特意让我们备了一些。”
林远一边倒茶一边说。
云昊端起茶碗喝了一口：“顾长风现在在哪里？”

林远说：“顾师叔祖半月前处理完宗门事务后，已经出发前往中天仙域了。
他临行前交代，云宗主到了太虚城只管住下，他已经安排了人在城中等您。
另外他还说，若是云宗主有兴趣，可以先去太虚宗看看，他已传讯回宗，宗主也欢迎云宗主去做客。”
content_en:
The boundary wall of Taixu Immortal Realm is like a warm gauze curtain. The ripples caused by the spirit boat passing through slowly spread on the blue-white light curtain, and then calmness returned.
Yun Hao stood on the bow of the boat, looking into a world completely different from the Jingxuan Immortal Realm.
The sky is a deep ink blue, and the clouds are low and thick, like cotton wool soaked in ink piled between the distant mountains and the sky.
The mountains on the land are undulating, and the outlines of the peaks are looming in the mist. The mountains are scattered with large and small lakes. The lake water is as clear as a mirror, reflecting the dark blue of the sky, connecting the sky and the earth into a seamless picture.
The air is filled with rich wood-attributed fairy energy, with the unique refreshing breath of vegetation. After taking a deep breath, you can feel that the Hunyuan fairy power in the meridians is running a little smoother.
It didn't matter where they were going along the way, but they didn't expect to arrive at the Taixu Immortal Domain, Gu Changfeng's territory.
Fu Rong walked to him: "Jingxuan Immortal Realm is famous for the power of metal and stone, while Taixu Immortal Realm is famous for the vitality of wood.
The wood attribute immortal energy here is several times richer than that in the Jingxuan Immortal Realm. It is a heaven-sent place for monks who practice wood attribute techniques. "
But for you, the power of building wood is in perfect harmony with the laws of heaven and earth here, and your cultivation speed should be faster than in the Jingxuan Immortal Realm. "
Yun Hao didn't speak, just nodded slightly.
He could feel the power of the building trees responding to the world, just like the roots felt the moist soil.
The shadow of the black ancient tree trembled slightly in the dantian, and then calmed down.
The spirit boat flew on the edge of the Taixu Immortal Realm for two days. The scenery along the way gradually changed from vast mountains to gentle hills. There were some villages and towns scattered on the hills. They were not large in scale, but they were all shrouded in the rich wood-attribute fairy energy.
In the early morning of the third day, a large-scale city appeared on the horizon ahead.
The city is built against the mountain. The city wall is made of blue boulders. The cracks in the stones are covered with emerald green moss, which glows with a warm luster in the morning light.
A thin layer of white mist hangs above the city wall, like a light veil covering the top of the city.
A huge wooden plaque hangs above the city gate, engraved with three simple characters - "Taixu City"
Fu Rong slowed down the speed of the spirit boat: "Taixu City is the most important town in the south of Taixu Immortal Territory, and it is also an important transit point to Zhongtian Immortal Territory.
From here, walk east for another three months and you will reach the cross-border teleportation array between the Immortal Realms. "
Yun Hao glanced at the outline of the city: "Let's stop here for a day. "
The spirit boat landed at the dock outside Taixu City.
The dock is not big, but there are several spirit boats of different styles moored, some from the Jingxuan Immortal Realm, some from the more distant Beichen Immortal Realm, and there are also several black bone boats with ancient runes that Yun Hao does not recognize engraved on the boats.
Yunhao stepped off the spirit boat and walked toward the city along the bluestone-paved streets.
Most of the shops on both sides of the street are made of wood, with patterns of flowers, plants and vines carved on the door lintels. There are medicine shops, talisman shops, and magic treasure pavilions. An inconspicuous teahouse caught Yunhao's attention.
There is a wooden table at the entrance of the teahouse, and an old wooden sign is placed on the table, which reads "Taixu Sect Foreign Affairs Reception Office"
A few words.
When Yun Hao walked to the door of the teahouse, a young disciple wearing a green Taoist robe happened to walk out of it. When he saw Yun Hao, he was stunned for a moment, and then his eyes stopped on him.
The young disciple stepped forward quickly, cupped his hands and said, "May I ask if you are the master of Wanxu Sect Yun? "
Yun Hao glanced at him: "Do you know me? "
A look of surprise appeared on the face of the young disciple: "Lin Yuan, a junior inner disciple of Taixu Sect, has seen the portrait of Sect Master Yun in the sect's classics.
Master Gu's uncle sent a message back to the sect the day before yesterday, saying that sect leader Yun was on his way to the Zhongtian Immortal Realm. He asked us to pay attention and be sure to receive him well if we encounter him.
Sect Master Yun, please come with this junior. "
He stepped aside to open the door and said "please"
gesture.
Yun Hao didn't refuse and walked away.Entered the teahouse.
The teahouse is not big but it is clean and bright, and the street view can be seen from the seats by the window.
Lin Yuan led him to sit down in the elegant seat and made a pot of tea himself. The tea soup was green and translucent, and the fragrance was fragrant.
"This is the 'Green Wood Spirit Bud' which is a specialty of the Taixu Immortal Domain. Uncle Gu said that Sect Master Yun likes to drink tea, so he specially asked us to prepare some."
Lin Yuan said while pouring tea.
Yun Hao picked up the tea bowl and took a sip: "Where is Gu Changfeng now?"
Lin Yuan said: "Uncle Gu, after handling the sect's affairs half a month ago, has already set off for the Zhongtian Immortal Realm.
Before he left, he told him that Sect Leader Yun would just stay here when he arrived in Taixu City. He had already arranged for someone to wait for you in the city.
In addition, he also said that if Sect Master Yun is interested, he can go to Taixu Sect first. He has sent a message back to the sect, and Sect Master also welcomes Sect Master Yun to be a guest. "
